The User Journey for Space Printer lite was completed this month. This is the completion of milestone 1 for our project. To complete this milestone we created and delivered a Presentation with diagrams and a Video released on YouTube. The team has continued integrating the new design elements into our Figma design documents, and coding is underway on the marketplace in our development environments.

ms.report: A Figma document which shows the new features of Adosia Marketplace and where they interact with the Spaceprinter Lite back end services. Each phase of the Spaceprinter lite connectivity is called out from our Milestone 1 submission. We color coded each of the interactions that occur, and then shared where those interactions are happening on the front end. We include all of the front end screens that have connection to the back end Spaceprinter lite interface. The Figma document is here: https://www.figma.com/file/cPBkeVomYAXekL3ELwCjKF/Adosia-%7C-Space-Printer-Light?type=design&node-id=0%3A1&t=Tgx9AxmFHgxxr9zN-1

ms.promise: Github viewing via video, and report of commits/issues.
ms.criteria: A viewer of the video can see that code is completed. The commits and issues report will show the progress that has been made in the github project.
ms.report:
We have crafted the video for Milestone 3 showing the Github Commits in the Marketplace TX Builder (Space Printer Lite). The video shows commits from the end of Fund 8, into March of this year when we achieved functionality, through this week, as we have completed bug fixes from our Incentivized Test Net. The video also describes where Spaceprinter Lite interacts with our front end Adosia.Market marketplace.

The video is available here: https://youtu.be/fwPlTXMFbkk
